art_direction: 深祖母绿波浪发女性在清晨花市挑选白色洋桔梗，浅杏衬衫与靛蓝长裙颜色鲜明。
composition_variation: Paint an original anime portrait of a visibly adult 26-year-old woman selecting a flower at an otherwise empty summer market stall. Give her luminous amber eyes, elegant brows, a softly defined jaw, a small straight nose, and a bright yet composed smile. Deep emerald-green hair falls in long waves, with the upper section tied by a small beige ribbon. She wears an opaque pale-apricot short-sleeved cotton blouse with a modest round neckline, an indigo calf-length skirt, and comfortable cream flats. She stands beside low metal flower buckets, holding a single white lisianthus stem upright at lower-chest level while her other hand lightly carries a small paper-wrapped bouquet against her waist. Her gaze examines the petals with a relaxed thoughtful expression. Keep arms close and hands clearly visible, with no sprawling gestures. White blossoms, dusty lilac flowers, and muted foliage create a rich but orderly lower foreground; a pale canvas awning remains low or outside the central upper space. Early morning light gives the petals subtle translucence while all clothing stays opaque. Balance emerald, apricot, indigo, and warm white in a polished, airy anime aesthetic. Use an eye-level portrait composition, with one person centered in the middle-to-lower frame and hands held within the central crop. Leave the upper quarter as clean pale sky or light for the lock-screen clock.
